reply_text:
I found two new candidates from 2026 that aren't on your recorded list. Both are weak, and you should check them before relying on them.

1. **7 January essay on Zhihu.** Lee called 2026 "the first year of multi-agent systems going to work in Chinese companies". I didn't open the Zhihu post itself. I read it on Sina, which reprints TechWeb's copy and introduces it as the original text of his post. This is the same idea as your 4 February file on AI agents taking off in 2026, but said a month earlier in a different place. I've linked it to that file; drop the link if you count it as a separate claim.

2. **22 July Caixin interview at the World Artificial Intelligence Conference.** Lee expects AI to reshape large companies' financial reporting and management "within the next year." These are the reporter's words, not his: the rest of the article is behind a paywall, and the page quotes none of his words directly. The claim is about AI's effect on companies, so it sits near the line between an AI forecast and a business forecast.

**What I left out or couldn't check:**
- **The Lisa Su conversation (AMD event, Shanghai, 19 May).** The printed interview says 2026's key question is whether AI can replace a whole company department. That frames a question rather than predicting anything, so I didn't list it. His line that a truly "autonomous company" will one day exist has no date and isn't about general AI (AGI), so it's out too.
- **Same essay, other prediction.** He thinks China's big-model market will end up dominated by DeepSeek, Alibaba's Qwen and ByteDance. That's a business forecast with no date, so it's out.
- **Pages that wouldn't open.** Semafor's 18 September interview (blocked) and Huxiu's interview at the AI conference in July (not accessible). The Semafor search snippet mentions a "three-to-five-year buffer" for businesses far from AI, but I didn't read it on the page, so I haven't quoted it.
- **Bloomberg, 4 September.** I didn't open it; your existing five-year jobs file covers what the search snippets showed.

I used 9 of 12 searches and all 6 page openings.
